name: Lumbosacral Radiculoplexus Neuropathy
definition: Painful inflammatory ischemic neuropathy affecting lumbosacral roots, plexus and peripheral nerves, classically associated with diabetes but also occurring idiopathically.

investigations.principle: Electrodiagnostics and MRI pelvis/lumbosacral plexus help localization and exclusion of structural causes.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Immunotherapy is individualized; malignancy and compressive causes must be excluded.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vata-neuropathy phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Painful inflammatory ischemic neuropathy affecting lumbosacral roots, plexus and peripheral nerves, classically associated with diabetes but also occurring idiopathically.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected serious infection, sepsis, pathological instability or other listed red flags.
